question: What attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are paired attainments
Great accomplishment is the stated result
Being dear to the yoginīs follows from this attainment
inference: One who attains enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may attain enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment, and become dear to the yoginīs.
